title: Secretary Problem Thresholds and Convergents of $1/e$
body_text:
Secretary Problem Thresholds and Convergents of $1/e$

We prove that if $p/q$ is a continued fraction convergent of $1/e$ with $q\geq 3$, then, for the secretary problem with $q$ applicants, the optimal number of initially rejected applicants is $p$.

Authors: Raúl Sánchez Galán
Categories: math.PR, math.NT, math.PR
